about: Cavan Monaghan is a township in Peterborough County, Ontario, wrapping around the southwest side of the City of Peterborough—not the city itself. Millbrook’s historic mill village, Cavan hamlet, and farmland toward the Ganaraska country define the township. About 10,000 people live in Cavan Monaghan.
seoSummary: Peterborough County township around Millbrook—historic mill village and farmland, not the City of Peterborough.
